text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired — HIGH GPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE on cluster-prod-gpu-7. Alert ID: PD-53421. Node: gpu-node-7. Affected pods: 12. https://pd.example/pd/PD-53421 :fire:

pagerduty: Triggered to on-call (sam).

sam: acked, I'm on it.

sam: seeing repeated "CUDA out of memory" errors in inference-model-x logs. KV cache growth looks unbounded.

sam: quick checks: nvidia-smi shows GPU0 98% memory used. PID 2345 (infra-worker).

sam: running commands now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra top pod inference-model-x-5f7c
kubectl -n infra exec inference-model-x-5f7c -- nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY
``` 

cassie: if it's a batch job spiking at midnight, probably cron overlap. can we throttle or kill the job first to stop the immediate pressure?

devon: agree. plan: cordon+drain node after we kill the runaway to avoid more evictions: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 && kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

sam: I can kill the process PID 2345 in the pod. Doing `kubectl exec -n infra inference-model-x-5f7c -- kill -9 2345` now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-53421 acknowledged by sam :white_check_mark:.

sam: killed. Re-checking nvidia-smi — GPU memory dropped to ~34%, pods recovering.

sam: rolling restart of inference-model-x to pick older image tag to be safe: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-model-x -n infra`.

maria: customer impact? Any 5xx/timeout spikes?

cassie: looking at routing logs — we saw ~2.3k 504s to /v1/embeddings over the last 10m. Tail latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s for affected requests. A subset of Dedicated customers reported timeouts.

devon: temporarily lowered concurrency limit on model route: `autoshedder config set --max-concurrency 8 --route /v1/embeddings` to reduce OOM risk.

sam: enabled temporary autoshedder config via console. Also added temporary quota to batch job service account.

pagerduty: Escalation to L2 after 8m (eng-ml notified).

cassie: taking over watch. Sam — thanks, good handoff. I'm going to monitor for 30m and run drain if we see pressure again.

maria: follow-ups: (1) add resource requests/limits to the nightly batch job, (2) add alert: sustained GPU mem > 75% for 5m -> page L2, (3) add a guard in job sched to stagger cron starts. Assigning (3) to devon, (2) to maria, (1) to cassie.

devon: noted, will open PR for staggers and kubejob limits.

sam: my shift ends in ~25m so handing off to cassie. leaving logs and commands in the incident ticket.

cassie: ack — I'm on watch. will create incident doc PD-53421-IR with timeline and root cause hypothesis (batch cron overlap + missing resource limits + unbounded KV cache growth in model X).

incident-bot: Incident PD-53421 status set to: mitigated -> monitoring. Ticket created: https://pd.example/pd/PD-53421-IR :information_source:

sam: thanks everyone. adding note: consider upstream model cache eviction after N tokens to avoid KV blowup.

cassie: will include that in postmortem. closing Slack thread for now but will update when IR out.
